responsibility: Serves as the entry point for the rustc-to-stable conversion layer by organizing ABI, MIR, type, and error submodules and defining shared Stable conversions for common rustc HIR and span primitives used across those converters.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `rustc_smir/mod.rs`, which owns the shared tables and core `Stable` infrastructure, this `mod.rs` is the leaf conversion hub that groups the ABI/MIR/type/error converters and provides concrete `Stable` impls for common frontend primitives like HIR enums, symbols, and spans. Unlike `rustc_internal/mod.rs`, it does not expose runtime bridge APIs or stable-to-internal translation.
